freeze_order: All field families and parameters below are frozen before model-backed transition fields are generated or inspected.

trajectory_split.unit: whole generated trajectory keyed by prompt_index and generation seed

amplitude.notes: DGCT v1 fits one scalar amplitude per observer and frozen field. Affine a(q) is implemented but not enabled in this preregistration.

complexity.notes: No weighted scalar complexity score is primary. MDL is not computed in v1.

claim_boundary.general_dynamic_gauge: Supported only by simpler, better-generalizing and/or more cross-model-concordant residuals under a shared frozen field; a small next-step R2 increase is insufficient.
claim_boundary.vortex_specific: Requires vortex_smooth to beat complexity-matched non-vortical controls; otherwise only a generic dynamic-gauge claim may survive.
claim_boundary.navier_stokes: Not tested in DGCT v1. A self-similar or Navier-Stokes-inspired field is intentionally deferred until simpler fields earn it.
